notes.title: Thank you + Transcript
notes.content:
Hi, and thank you. 

I've been incredibly humbled and honored by each of you that have played and enjoyed my (grandmothers) game. All I hoped was to make at least one person feel something and your response has been overwhelming.

Your feedback has meant the world. Thank you.

I've received a few requests for captions to be implemented, but I'm a god awful programmer and for the life of me can't implement them. In place of captions, please accept this transcript:
[url=https://epimetheus.digital]
https://epimetheus.digital
[/url]

Sincerely,
Epimetheus.
